subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class Telegram album sending now, and if so should it be a new send-media-group action or automatic batching of eligible existing mediaUrls?
rationale: This is new user-facing Telegram/message-tool behavior with API-shape choices and an open fork implementation, so automation should not choose the permanent contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Review or port the open implementation
options.body: Use the existing open fork PR as the starting point, but adapt it to current durable Telegram delivery and decide the final action/schema shape before merge.

options.title: Batch existing mediaUrls only
options.body: Avoid a new global action name and implement Telegram-only album batching for eligible existing multi-media sends, leaving the message-tool API smaller.

options.title: Decline album support for now
options.body: Keep current sequential multi-media delivery and close this issue plus linked album PRs as not planned if the product cost is not worth the extra Telegram-specific behavior.

recommendation.title: Review or port the open implementation
recommendation.body: Use the existing open fork PR as the starting point, but adapt it to current durable Telegram delivery and decide the final action/schema shape before merge.
